commands.command:
set -eu
MAC=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
TARGET=fbeefb174c309a252e82b47b20dbe3bf63217485
PREVIOUS=ac898d465bfca86d4259cdf76abea1dadb2e1f4c
backup=/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/.dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre
test "$(git -C "$MAC" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(git -C "$MAC" status --porcelain=v1)"
test -f "$MAC/frontend/dist/index.html"
INDEX_SHA="$(shasum -a 256 "$MAC/frontend/dist/index.html" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$INDEX_SHA" = d654499fcacc770517afd462bd0c3902147033e45a999655f4c8b88ab26e10cf
SSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10"
$SSH "$PI" "test -f '$backup/app-before.sqlite' && test -f '$backup/frontend/index.html' && mkdir -p '$backup/frontend-next'"
RSYNC_RSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10" rsync -az --delete "$MAC/frontend/dist/" "$PI:$backup/frontend-next/"
$SSH "$PI" bash -s -- "$TARGET" "$PREVIOUS" "$INDEX_SHA" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
TARGET="$1"
PREVIOUS="$2"
INDEX_SHA="$3"
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=.dev/deploy/2026-10-31-trackpad-zoom-pre
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PREVIOUS"
test "$(cat "$BACKUP/previous-main-sha.txt")" = "$PREVIOUS"
test -f "$BACKUP/app-before.sqlite"
test -f "$BACKUP/frontend/index.html"
test "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP/frontend-next/index.html" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$INDEX_SHA"
printf 'PI_PRE_DEPLOY_HEALTH='
curl -fsS --max-time 6 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf '\n'
REMOTE_URL="$(git remote get-url origin)"
case "$REMOTE_URL" in
  https://github.com/MichalMatu/PhotoMaps.git|https://github.com/MichalMatu/photomap.git) ;;
  *) echo "UNEXPECTED_PI_ORIGIN=$REMOTE_URL"; exit 3 ;;
esac
git remote set-url origin https://github.com/MichalMatu/photomap.git
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$TARGET"
git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
rsync -a --delete "$BACKUP/frontend-next/" frontend/dist/
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$INDEX_SHA"
PHOTOMAP_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 make server-restart
printf 'PI_POST_DEPLOY_HEALTH='
curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf '\n'
printf 'PI_POST_FRONTEND_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
printf 'PI_POST_MAP_HTTP='
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
db=sqlite3.connect('file:backend/data/app.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
assert db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] == "ok"
for name in ("place","photo","memory"):
 print('PI_POST_'+name.upper(),db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "+name).fetchone()[0])
assert db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place").fetchone()[0] == 195
assert db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo").fetchone()[0] == 1140
print("PI_POST_SQLITE_INTEGRITY=ok")
PY
printf 'PI_POST_MAIN_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'PI_POST_WORKTREE_DIRTY=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'PI_POST_DIST_INDEX_SHA=%s\n' "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'PI_POST_ORIGIN=%s\n' "$(git remote get-url origin)"
make server-status
make tunnel-status
rm -r "$BACKUP/frontend-next"
echo PHOTOMAP_PI_DEPLOY_PASS
REMOTE
printf 'MAC_MAIN_SHA=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'MAC_MAIN_DIRTY=%s\n' "$(git -C "$MAC" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo PHOTOMAP_DEPLOY_COMPLETE
